text:
Lorenzo Bettoni and Richard Hall return with a new episode of the Football Italia Show to look ahead to the midweek Serie A action, with several intriguing fixtures, injury concerns and potential pitfalls for some of Italy’s biggest clubs.
Click here to subscribe to the official Football Italia YouTube channel.
Roma prepare to welcome Cagliari to the Stadio Olimpico, but Paulo Dybala’s injury absence is a significant blow for the Giallorossi. Can Roma secure all three points without one of their key attacking players, or could Cagliari pose an unexpected threat?
Latest Football Italia YouTube show – Serie A midweek fixtures
Elsewhere, Como travel to Torino in a fixture that could prove more complicated than it appears on paper. Both sides will look to make the most of the opportunity, but hidden traps may await teams that underestimate their opponents.
Click here to follow Tuesday’s Serie A games live
Napoli, Juventus and Milan also face selection problems as injuries threaten to complicate their preparations for a busy midweek schedule. With squad depth and tactical flexibility likely to play important roles, how will the leading sides cope with their absences?
In the latest episode of the Football Italia Show, Lorenzo and Richard discuss the key talking points, assess the potential challenges facing Serie A’s biggest clubs and consider where the surprises could come from.
What are your predictions for the midweek Serie A fixtures? Share your thoughts in the comments below.
digest_he: לקראת משחקי אמצע השבוע בליגה האיטלקית, מציגים פרשני התוכנית Football Italia Show את המוקשים הממתינים לקבוצות הגדולות. רומא תארח את קליארי כשהיא חסרה את פאולו דיבאלה הפצוע, חיסרון משמעותי בחלק ההתקפי. במקביל, קבוצות כמו נאפולי, יובנטוס ומילאן מתמודדות אף הן עם בעיות סגל ופציעות המקשות על ההכנות ללוח המשחקים הצפוף. הפרשנים דנים באתגרים העומדים בפני המועדונים המובילים ובוחנים היכן עשויות להתרחש הפתעות במחזור הקרוב.
